programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

In this video, we visit a range of shipping container projects, such as Buck Street market and Container City in London, in order to investigate the legibility for growth in the future.
Some people think these buildings are a ‘scam’ while others think they are the future, so let's find out.

programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.title: The Inspire Action Podcast
programme.desc:
What does it mean to be part of nature, not apart from it? And how can an ancient philosophy guide us toward practical, systemic change in the modern world?
In this episode of the Inspire Action Podcast Ciara sits down with Dr. Simon Sadinsky - professor, Executive Director of Education, and in-house Harmony advisor at the Kings Foundation - to explore a philosophy that has guided cultures and peoples around the world for millennia, but is now finally being integrated into Western thought via a few key changemakers along the way. It shouldn’t be revolutionary, but it is in our world where progress often comes at the cost of the natural world around us.
Simon reminds us that Harmony isn't just philosophy - it's a practical roadmap for action. This conversation will hopefully shift how you see your place in the world, and remind you (as it did for us) that we all have a part to play in creating the Harmony our planet so desperately needs.
programme.sub-title: How Can We Reconnect with Nature? with Dr. Simon Sadinsky

programme.title: Woodworking For Beginners
programme.desc: I'm gonna talk a bit about my miter saw, and try to give you a beginner's guide on how to use a miter saw.
programme.sub-title: Miter Saw - Beginners Guide, How To Use Miter Saws

programme.title: Bold Backyards
programme.desc: This DIY raised planter is fully made out of cinder blocks! These blocks are staked and then filled with dirt and rock. Traditionally you would pour a concrete footing and then stack the block; I wanted to see if it would work with rock and block adhesive. I love how it turned out, and it's doing amazing so far. If I were in a more wet area, I would have installed a drain, we are in a pretty dry area, and this dirt is mostly granite, clay, and rock. I have found there isn't much settling that occurs in this area.
programme.sub-title: DIY Raised Planter Box from CINDER BLOCKS.mp4

programme.sub-title: How To Regrow Scallions From Scraps - Zero Waste Food Tutorial + Harvest

programme.title: Ashley Renne: Sustainable Home
programme.desc: Make sustainable changes to your home with these 7 zero-waste swaps for beginners.

programme.desc: At The Greenwich House, Sabine created a custom barn door out of reclaimed wood from an old barn in Connecticut. It has quickly become a fan favorite within the home. Find out what it takes to get this look and create a custom reclaimed barn door for your own home.

programme.title: Simple Dwelling
programme.desc: On a block measuring only 76m2 (818sqft), it was split in half with a pair of three-bedroom vertical townhouses, which meant they couldn't go 'out', so they went 'up'.
programme.sub-title: This Black Metal Townhouse Design is Inspired by a Handbag

programme.title: Ashley Renne: Sustainable Travel
programme.desc: On World Environment Day 2019, history was made -- and Ashley Renne got a chance to be apart of it. The United Airlines "Flight For The Planet" crew flew Ashley and other passengers from Chicago to Los Angeles on the most Eco-Friendly flight in aviation history.
programme.sub-title: Ep 3 - Is This The Most Eco-friendly Flight In History | Biofuel + Zero Waste

programme.title: Simple Dwelling
programme.desc: The need for a new development model is desperately needed, a model which is sustainable and financially accessible with a focus on townhouses in urban locations. Davison Collaborative is that sustainable development model, with ethical developers Liam Wallis and Katya Crema of HIP V. HYPE teaming up with architect Chris Gilbert from Archier to design, build and develop three sustainable townhouses in Brunswick. Oh did we mention they also live here?

programme.title: Going Green Architecture & Design
programme.desc: We visited the world's most sustainable cities to find out what is the most sustainable city in the world. In these green cities, we found architecture & sustainable developments which are saving our future. From Copenhagen to Singapore to Songdo, you will see a range of eco-friendly cities in this video before the most sustainable city in the world is revealed!
programme.sub-title: What Is the Most Sustainable City in the World?

programme.title: Going Green Architecture & Design
programme.desc:
We take a look at the top ten sustainable, off-grid homes from around the world, assessing the design and build of each structure, and learning how we can all be more resourceful, and reduce our impact on the planet.
Although living off-grid can be challenging and requires an environmental learning curve, it can have numerous positive benefits like conserving energy, reducing living costs, and helping people feel more connected to nature.
programme.sub-title: Top 10 Off-Grid Sustainable Homes from Around the World

programme.title: Going Green Architecture & Design
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit an eco-hotel where one man has self-built a variety of eco stays using recycled materials. The site is like a tiny house community and includes two converted planes, yurts, and a UFO!
programme.sub-title: Man Builds ECO-HOTEL From Recycled Materials

programme.title: America ByDesign
programme.desc: Season 2 concludes with standout American design—from a visionary cultural campus and next-generation workplace to a resilient community project and a bold urban redevelopment shaping the future.

programme.title: Landscape Design
programme.desc: Vee takes you on a tour of her studio and nursery, including bees, chickens and some very cool plants. Learn how the senses: sight, smell, sound, touch and taste (plus the added bonus of time!) combine to create inspiring sanctuaries that uplift and connect you to nature.
programme.sub-title: Landscape Design : Bay Area by Vee Horticulture | Berkeley, California

programme.title: Desert Architecture
programme.desc: After a mountainside home is devastated by a flash flood architect Brent Kendle AIA, LEED AP of Kendle Design Collaborative tears the lid off, as well as most of the walls, creating a new architectural vision of light, art, and forever views. Experience this stunning home in detail through the owners' eyes and words. This is a home that gets up close and personal with its mountain host while appearing to soar off its hillside perch to join the raptors as they glide amongst the magnificence of this valley of paradise.

programme.title: The Ultimate Reno
programme.desc: Free ad-supported linear TV for the home design & sustainable living audience. Modern interiors, eco landscaping, smart home, outdoor living, and eco travel.

programme.title: Desert Architecture
programme.desc: This extraordinary, contemporary southwest home located behind the gates of the secluded community of Eagles Nest in Fountain Hills, Arizona is a luxurious, architectural-masterpiece, has 4 bedrooms, 6 bathroom home, with over 8,200 spacious square feet of custom features such as an elevator, air-conditioned garage with custom roll-up glass garage doors, an RV garage, fire and water features throughout, interior and exterior lit stairs and a custom, modern “cloud ceiling”.

programme.title: BYOT Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Brent transforms an ordinary backyard shed into a fully equipped home gym—tackling insulation, drywall, flooring, and clever storage to create a functional fitness space.
programme.sub-title: How To Turn A Shed Into A Home Gym

programme.desc: Home design trends are always changing. But, what is the right choice for your home? Sabine meets with Mahdad Saniee, architect at The Greenwich House to learn about some of the design choices that created such a unique and highly livable home.

programme.title: Desert Architecture
programme.desc: Drawing on the roots of Spanish Colonial homes originally built in the Arcadia Neighborhood this new home sits on ¾ acre lot just south of Camelback Road. The homes three-car garage protrudes out from the main home, forming an intimate courtyard on the front of the home. Noise is buffered from nearby Camelback Road by the mass of the garage. A fireplace provides a focal point to the space.

programme.title: Landscape Design
programme.desc: Onsite at the first project Landscape Fusion and Chibi Moku made the creative decision to take advantage of a major installation day on the active project in Seminole, FL to showcase the level of coordination and reliance on skilled craftsmanship that is essential to Landscape Fusion’s success as an outdoor living design/build company.
programme.sub-title: Behind the Landscape by Landscape Fusion | Tampa, Florida

programme.title: Ideas For Your Home
programme.desc: If you have pets or delicate plantings, it's essential to install deer fencing on your property to keep deer and other animals away. But most often, fence installers place these in unsightly locations. I wanted an alternative and devised a more robust post to allow for greater spans of netting, rendering the deer fencing on my property virtually invisible. Have a look to see how I did it.

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign

programme.title: Desert Architecture

programme.desc: Welcome to the Passive House Ranch! Homeowners Beate and Bern have created a state of the art modern home while preserving the structure's original character. Their passive house has a classic ranch design with high-performance features that bring next-level comfort.

programme.desc: Passive House is an easy to understand building standard that takes home energy efficiency to a whole new level using 5 building standards that are explained in this video.

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours

programme.title: Desert Architecture
programme.desc: Think modern architecture is stark, cold, better to look at than to live in? programme.title: Simple Dwelling
programme.desc: Living off the grid in a sustainable, comfortable home is a dream for many, that was certainly the brief that came to Ben Callery Architects. programme.sub-title: A Home That Epitomises Off-Grid Living
